user.title: TotalEnergies Stations (unofficial)
user.description: Unofficial integration. Uses the public but undocumented web interface of the TotalEnergies station map (France). Private, non-commercial use only.

search.title: Search stations
search.description: Stations within the radius are searched once. Afterwards only the selected stations are polled.

select.title: Select stations
select.description: {count} stations found. Select up to {max} stations.

manual.title: Station IDs
manual.description: One or more station IDs (e.g. NF012345), separated by comma or new line. Maximum {max}.

error.key_discovery_failed: The public keys could not be read from the station map scripts. The website may have changed.
error.no_stations: No stations found in this radius.
error.no_selection: Please select at least one station.

init.title: Options
init.description: Please keep the poll interval gentle (minimum 15 minutes).
